frame: Rater frame: conservative home-layer test. If the assigned failure mode remains open, do not give 2. If evidence is a draft, optional extension, or marketing page, cap the cell at 1. Prefer the lower score when mixed.

C.promise: Signed W3C VC mandates scope agent authority for L4 payment commitment.
C.evidence: Intent/Cart Mandates as VCs; chain of evidence intent→cart→payment method.
C.failure: Revocation not consistently propagated into settlement (L4 open issue).
C.metric: Mandate signature validity vs. settlement authorization match.
C.locator: spec-ap2; ind-google-ap2-blog; ledger L4 open issue

I.promise: Binds to A2A, MCP, x402, UCP; payment-agnostic across cards/stablecoins/bank transfers.
I.evidence: UCP spec references AP2 mandates; A2A x402 extension named; 60+ collaborators.
I.failure: Bindings are suggested/adapter-level; no auditable cross-rail verification spec.
I.metric: Count of independently verified cross-protocol implementations.

A.promise: Authorization via signed VCs; audit trail; price/timing conditions in mandate.
A.evidence: Intent/Cart Mandates, non-repudiable chain of evidence, payment-agnostic rails.
A.failure: No economic finality, compliance continuity, or recoverability artifacts.
A.metric: 4/7 properties addressed (auth safety, exec partial, price partial, audit yes).

EM.promise: Payment-agnostic: supports real-time bank transfers alongside cards/stablecoins.
EM.evidence: Blog lists real-time bank transfers as a supported rail.
EM.failure: Still depends on formal ID/KYC for mandates; no offline or court-less remedy.
EM.metric: Usability without card network or formal KYC bureau.

S.promise: Public GitHub spec, reference implementations, broad industry collaboration.
S.failure: No named governance body or standards-track process; spec not versioned by SDO.
S.metric: Presence of versioned spec under named governance or SDO process.

C.promise: HTTP 402 + cryptographic payment proof binds authorization to settlement.
C.evidence: spec-x402 documents PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header and facilitator verify/settle flow.
C.failure: Payment finality is not atomically bound to delivery (L5 open failure T3).
C.metric: Presence of signed payment proof vs. service completion evidence.

I.promise: Blockchain-agnostic settlement with CAIP-2 network IDs; optional Bazaar discovery.
I.evidence: SDKs for EVM, Solana, Algorand; AP2/A2A extension references.
I.failure: Bindings to other layers are optional or one-sided (Bazaar, Signed Offers/Receipts).
I.metric: Count of cross-layer bindings that are mandatory vs. optional.

A.promise: Auth via signed mandate; execution via facilitator verify; audit via optional receipts.
A.evidence: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, exact/upto schemes, optional Signed Offers & Receipts.
A.failure: Economic finality, compliance, and recoverability lack deployed artifacts.
A.metric: 3/7 properties addressed (auth_safety, exec_correct partial, price_correct partial, auditability).

EM.promise: No KYC/accounts needed; stablecoin rails reduce currency instability dependence.
EM.evidence: Zero-friction base flow; CAIP-2 multi-chain SDKs.
EM.failure: Still depends on platform trust (facilitator) and lacks legal enforcement fallback.
EM.metric: Institutional dependencies remaining: platform trust, legal enforcement.

S.promise: Public spec, multiple independent SDKs, Linux Foundation x402 Foundation.
S.evidence: TS/Go/Python SDKs; middleware integrations; IETF drafts in progress.
S.failure: Core refund/compliance receipts remain IETF drafts; governance adoption not fully independent.
S.metric: Versioned spec exists; independent implementers present; standards body process nascent.

C.promise: L6 commerce lifecycle: catalog, cart, checkout, fulfillment, refunds.
C.evidence: spec-ucp defines order objects, fulfillment events, adjustments.
C.failure: Post-purchase state and refund portability remain merchant-specific (T4).

I.promise: Bindings to AP2, A2A, MCP; /.well-known/ucp business profile.
I.evidence: Transport adapters and capability intersection defined in spec.
I.failure: Payment finality delegated to PSP/card rails, not bound end-to-end.
I.metric: Verifiable cross-layer binding to settlement rail.

A.promise: OAuth identity linking, order webhooks, refund adjustments, AP2 mandates.
A.evidence: Authorization via OAuth; execution via order/fulfillment objects; audit via webhooks.
A.failure: No economic finality, compliance continuity, or agent-speed recoverability.

EM.promise: continue_url fallback to merchant web checkout.
EM.evidence: Graceful degradation to web storefront when agent flow fails.
EM.failure: Still depends on card/PSP/bank rails and merchant trust; no offline or court-free remedy.
EM.metric: Usability without formal banking or platform trust.

S.promise: Versioned spec, named governance, multiple industry endorsers.
S.evidence: ucp.dev spec with version dates; GitHub repo; Google/Shopify/Visa/Stripe endorsement.
S.failure: Lodging/food verticals 'coming soon'; thin corpus (n=36); no independent adoption count.
S.metric: Independent implementations and stable versioned spec.

C.promise: Portable identity + behavioral trust on L1; registry membership ≠ capability.
C.evidence: Three registries (identity ERC-721, reputation, validation) deployable as per-chain singletons.
C.failure: Identity ≠ capability or honest execution; capability claims not cryptographically guaranteed.
C.metric: Registration file with endpoints; getSummary with clientAddresses filter; validation 0–100.

I.promise: Optional cross-layer bindings via A2A/MCP/ENS/DID endpoints and x402Support flag.
I.evidence: Identity registry URIStorage includes endpoints for other layers; feedback MAY include proofOfPayment.
I.failure: Feedback does not bind AP2 mandate terms or x402 settlement; cross-chain reputation not specified.
I.metric: Presence of endpoint fields; optional x402Support boolean; proofOfPayment tx hash.

A.promise: Audit trail via on-chain reputation + validation hooks; optional recoverability via revoke.
A.evidence: giveFeedback/revoke/appendResponse; validation request/response hooks; IPFS optional.
A.failure: No enforcement of authorization, execution correctness, pricing, or compliance; Sybil-prone.
A.metric: Count of yes+partial properties = 3 (auditability yes; auth_safety partial; recoverability partial).

EM.promise: Reduced dependence on platform trust via on-chain identity and reputation.
EM.evidence: Deployable on L2; no mandatory KYC or banking; wallet-based registration.
EM.failure: Still needs chain access, gas, and external trust anchors (zkML/TEE/judges) for validation.
EM.metric: No dependency on cards, courts, or formal ID; fallback to wallet-only registration.

S.promise: Public EIP draft with named authors (MetaMask, EF, Google, Coinbase).
S.evidence: EIP-8004 Draft status; Magicians thread active; corpus companions cite operational readiness.
S.failure: Draft ERC, not final; no versioned governance or multiple independent implementations confirmed.
S.metric: EIP status = Draft; authors listed; no Last Call or Final.

C.promise: Machine-readable tool/resource discovery for agent-to-tool interop (L2/L3).
C.evidence: Capability discovery (prompts, resources, tools) documented in intro.
C.failure: Advertised capability not bound to demonstrated competence (L2 ledger).
C.metric: Fraction of advertised tools with verified execution traces.

I.promise: Client/server bindings across Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor; A2A/AG-UI/UCP reference MCP.
I.evidence: Multiple independent implementations; layered references in A2A, AG-UI, UCP docs.
I.failure: No auditable cross-layer binding of capability to performance; L3 intent fidelity open.
I.metric: Number of independent cross-layer adapters with verified traces.

A.evidence: Trust model mentions user-mediated delegation; no payment/settlement/compliance artifacts.
A.failure: No execution correctness, finality, pricing, audit, compliance, or recovery artifacts.
A.metric: Count of seven properties with observable artifacts (1 partial).

EM.promise: Reduces dependence on platform trust via open tool interface.
EM.evidence: Open standard usable without a single vendor; no banking/ID/legal dependency stated.
EM.failure: Still needs platform trust for client adoption; no fallback for weak institutions.

S.promise: Versioned open spec (2026-07-28) with broad independent implementations.
S.evidence: Multiple clients (Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, Cursor); versioned docs; A2A/AG-UI/UCP cite it.
S.failure: Governance body not named in packet; spec stability inferred from versioning.
S.metric: Independent implementers ≥ 4; versioned public spec present.

C.promise: Agent Card advertises capabilities; Task lifecycle routes requests across agents.
C.evidence: Live spec defines Agent Card JSON schema and Task message/part/artifact lifecycle.
C.failure: Capability claims unvalidated; completed task does not prove intent fidelity (L2/L3 ledger).
C.metric: Fraction of advertised skills matched by verified execution traces.

I.promise: HTTP/JSON transport; Agent Card URL binds identity to endpoint; complements MCP and AP2.
I.evidence: Spec defines Agent Card discovery and HTTP interactions; UCP uses Agent Card URL; AP2 extends A2A for payments.
I.failure: No auditable binding to payment rails or trust models; auth is header-level, not cross-layer verifiable.
I.metric: Count of distinct layer-seam bindings with verifiable artifacts.

A.promise: Task traces enable message auditability; auth declared on Agent Card.
A.failure: No economic finality, pricing, compliance, or recoverability; overprivilege and weak consent noted (arxiv-2505.12490v3).
A.metric: 2 of 7 properties addressed (auth partial, auditability partial).

EM.promise: HTTP/JSON works without cards or banks; Agent Card is self-published.
EM.failure: No offline fallback, no legal enforcement artifact, no stable-currency mechanism; auth assumes platform trust.
EM.metric: Usable without banks but needs fallback for identity and dispute.

S.promise: Linux Foundation project with multi-vendor TSC; SDKs in 6 languages; public spec.
S.failure: Spec is live but corpus lacks tagged record; governance maturity not yet evidenced by multiple independent implementations.
S.metric: TSC members ≥5; SDKs ≥6; versioned spec present.

C.promise: Stream agent state, UI intents, and user interactions for L7 presentation.
C.evidence: Event-based streaming, HITL interrupts, shared state, custom events in live docs.
C.failure: Interface transparency does not create enforceable remedy; T5 remains open.
C.metric: Event types and interrupt semantics defined; no checkable metric for information revelation.
C.locator: https://docs.ag-ui.com/ (overview; no spec-* record in corpus)

I.promise: Bind to MCP (tools) and A2A (agents); multiple framework integrations.
I.evidence: Integration table lists LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK, etc.; SDKs in Kotlin/Go/Dart/Java/Rust.
I.failure: One-sided adapter bindings; no auditable cross-layer guarantee or Web2–Web3 seam.
I.metric: Integration count is not a binding guarantee; no verifiable seam artifact.

A.promise: Observability via streaming events and interrupts.
A.evidence: Docs describe event streams and HITL pause/approve/edit/retry.
A.failure: No mandate, settlement, pricing, compliance, or recovery objects; auditability partial.
A.metric: Only 1 of 7 properties addressed (auditability partial); bin 0–1 → 0.

EM.evidence: Docs assume platform trust, stable currency, and formal ID for any downstream use.
EM.failure: Depends on platform and cards; no artifact for loss-bearer without those institutions.
EM.metric: No offline, low-trust, or court-free pathway documented.

S.promise: Open protocol with multiple framework integrations and SDKs.
S.evidence: GitHub repo, live docs, SDKs in several languages; originated from CopilotKit.
S.failure: No versioned spec or named governance body; single-origin open protocol.
S.metric: Public docs and repo exist; no standards-body process or independent governance.

C.promise: L8 contract enforcement via crowdsourced arbitration.
C.evidence: ERC-792/1497 arbitrator+arbitrable split; Escrow product; appeals hierarchy.
C.failure: Days-scale resolution, not agent-speed; not wired as default L8 for AP2/x402/UCP.
C.metric: Resolution latency; wiring as default L8.

I.promise: Binding to arbitrable contracts across L5/L6.
I.evidence: Escrow integration; ERC-792 interface adopted by multiple contracts.
I.failure: No default binding to AP2/x402/UCP; cross-layer propagation not auditable.
I.metric: Count of non-escrow protocols with native Kleros binding.

A.evidence: ERC-1497 evidence standard; on-chain votes; appeal rounds.
A.failure: Execution correctness and economic finality depend on arbitrable contract; compliance absent.
A.metric: Three properties addressed (auth safety partial, auditability yes, recoverability yes).

EM.evidence: On-chain arbitration; global juror pool; escrow product.
EM.failure: Still needs PNK stake, crypto rails, and legal recognition of awards (NY Convention not automatic).

S.evidence: ERC-792/1497; live since 2019; cooperative governance; Snapshot voting.
S.failure: No formal standards body process; limited independent L8 integrations.
S.metric: ERC adoption; governance maturity; implementer count.
